title: Snow Removal Form
subtitle: Residential Snow Removal: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Snow Removal Form covers drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone. The snow service coordinator records Residential Snow Removal activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Snow Removal Form keeps Residential Snow Removal exceptions visible until the snow service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Snow Removal Form at residence access, drive, walkway, steps, curb, and designated snow-storage area. Document drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone identity before Residential Snow Removal begins. Compare drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone findings with stated Residential Snow Removal criteria; route unresolved Residential Snow Removal issues to winter operations reviewer. For Snow Removal Form, confirm requirements for Residential Snow Removal. Ask winter operations reviewer to review Residential Snow Removal conditions beyond the snow service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Activity parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential Snow Removal, identify responsible parties, residence access, drive, walkway, steps, curb, and designated snow-storage area, and the linked drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone source.

fields.label: Service trigger, depth, timing, and priority area
Surface type, marker, obstacle, drainage, and product restriction

sections.title: Recorded quantities, results, and controls
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Snow Removal facts for drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Snow Removal operating checks
items: Snow depth, ice condition, and precipitation stage
Vehicle, pedestrian, emergency, and delivery access
Surface edge, marker, drain, hydrant, and hidden-obstacle location
Plowed or shoveled width and snow placement
Deicer or abrasive type, amount, and restricted area
Refreeze, drifting, residual ice, and return trigger

sections.title: Operating exception, outcome, and review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Snow Removal conditions; have snow service coordinator assign the next Residential Snow Removal owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Visibility, lightning, extreme condition, or unsafe equipment operation
Blocked drain, hydrant, road, or neighboring property
Refreeze or continuing storm defeats completed condition
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Snow Removal when safe operation, access, snow placement, drainage, hidden obstacle, or residual ice remains uncontrolled. Retain the available Residential Snow Removal proof and route unresolved drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone scope to snow service coordinator.
